title: Cap. IX Arg. 3 Sol: ministers must seek to bring every hearer to Christ — Augustine De correptione et gratia 15
pass_a_gloss: Finally that also is rightly deduced, that the intention and labor of the ministers of the Gospel ought to look thither, and that Paul's labor looked thither, that he might bring unto Christ all and singular those unto whom he announced the Gospel of Christ. For, as Augustine piously and prudently, We, not knowing who pertains unto the number of the predestined, who does not pertain, ought so to be affected with the affection of charity, that we will all to be saved, De corrupt. et grat. cap. 15.
pass_b_english: Finally it also follows that Gospel ministers' aim and labor — as Paul's did — ought to be to bring to Christ every one to whom they announce Christ's Gospel. As Augustine says with piety and prudence: not knowing who belongs to the number of the predestined and who does not, we ought to be so moved by charity that we will all to be saved (De corrept. et grat. 15).
source_text: Denique et illud recte deducitur, Intentionem et operam ministrorum Evangelicorum eo spectare oportere, ac Pauli operam eo spectasse, ut eos omnes et singulos ad Christum adduceret, quibus Evangelium Christi annunciavit. Nam, ut pie et prudenter Augustinus, Nos nescientes quis pertineat ad praedestinatorum numerum, quis non pertineat, sic affici debemus charitatis affectu, ut omnes velimus salvos fieri, De corrupt. et grat. cap. 15.
